title: juncus tenuis subsp. dudleyi
intro: Juncus tenuis subsp. dudleyi, commonly known as New Zealand rush, is a subspecies of the Juncus tenuis plant, a species of rushes that belongs to the family Juncaceae. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its therapeutic properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Juncus tenuis subsp. dudleyi include wound healing, anti-inflammatory effects, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other bioactive compounds that contribute to its therapeutic effects.
